description: PM-F1 / PM-F6 REGRESSION NET — deliberately NOT a reproduction, because the reported symptom did not reproduce. A real AI-vs-AI game on the TRIANGULAR crucible_of_battle zone with plans off deploys both armies with zero 'deployment failed' retries and zero units forced into Strategic Reserves — measured identically with and without the polygon guard, so this asserts the good state rather than proving a fix. It is started from the menu rather than a predeploy fixture because the saved fixtures carry a stale, nearly-rectangular crucible zone (PM-F3) and never exercise the triangle at all. An earlier version of this scenario also counted model centres outside their deployment zone at the end of deployment; that assertion was REMOVED because the game runs straight on into movement and the count was measuring units that had legitimately advanced — it read 38 without the fix and 42 with it, which is noise, not signal.
